ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across the central fluke mass, with high-intensity (white) pixels localized to the trailing edge and median notch region; approximate ratio 6:1 black-to-white.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity black mass spanning both lobes; high-intensity white pixels form a thin, irregular boundary along the entire trailing edge and a significant concentrated cluster at the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; narrow pixel convergence with a deep bounding-box vertical extension relative to the horizontal plane.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-to-mid amplitude serrations; continuous irregular peaks and valleys visible as white disruptions against the dark fluke body along the entire trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trailing edge trajectory from the median notch to the lateral tips; leading edge (bottom) presents a relatively flat, horizontally linear profile.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent high-intensity white indentation and pigmentation void at the apex of the median notch, diverging from standard notch geometry.
other_distinctive_markers: Continuous high-contrast white halo effect delineating the trailing edge from the background.
